svg.text: WhatsApp-first MCP health helper: the AI can read, log, remind and request. It cannot confirm, set limits or approve. Humans do that.
New HS256 JWT for every call, 60 s
audit_log: every tool call, who and why
Trends, alerts, medicines, sharing and consent
Signed sessions, one-time codes, rate limits
What the AI did: every tool call, 'Approvals by AI: 0'
Not an MCP tool: only a family member's click
Alert limits set on the dashboard as doctor-set values;
A refill is ordered only after a family member
approves it. request_refill only creates a request
Outside WhatsApp; no real order is placed
AMBER and RED alerts with reading time
family alerts, refill notices, weekly summary (retried until delivered)

Built and run in the demo: everything above, in mock mode (simulator, mock reader, mock voice). Built, not run live: Telegram, WhatsApp via Twilio, Twilio calls. Design only, not deployed: AWS (docs/AWS_ARCHITECTURE.md).
The model never holds identity or approval: identity is the signed per-call token, and approval is a click on the dashboard.
Numbered path: photo 1, adapter 2, inbox 3, MCP call 4, store and audit 5, delivery to the family 6.
